referenceFunction.generalComment: The multioutput-process " pyrometallurgical treatment Li-ion batteries " delivers the co-products "disposal, Li-ion batteries, pyrometallurgical” ,” steel, pyrometallurgical processing Li-ion batteries, at plant”, “Co powder, pyrometallurgical processing Li-ion batteries, at plant”, “non-Fe-metals, pyrometallurgical processing Li-ion batteries, at plant” and " MnO2 powder, pyrometallurgical processing Li-ion batteries, at plant ". The allocation is done 100% to the disposal process.; UUID: 188856e2-076e-488a-b733-36d6f4cd400e
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset represents the treatment of Li-Ion batteries from electric and electronic devices by a pyrometallurgical process. It includes energy & auxiliary consumption, waste production, emission (to air/to water) production and rough estimations of the efforts for infrastructure & transportation.
referenceFunction.name: Disposal, Li-ions batteries, pyrometallurgical

geography.text: Data from a European recycling company - used as global average data.

technology.text: Crushing of the batteries, followed by a neutralization and a processing step.
